```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(bslib)

# Load pre-aggregated data
dat <- readRDS("vigitel_aggregated.rds")

# Latest year in the dataset
latest_year <- max(dat$year)

# Helper: filter overall estimates (no demographic breakdown)
overall <- function(d) {
  d |> filter(capital == "Total", sex == "Total",
              age_group == "Total", education == "Total")
}

# Color palette
pal <- c("#2C3E50", "#E74C3C", "#3498DB", "#2ECC71",
         "#F39C12", "#9B59B6", "#1ABC9C", "#E67E22")
```

# Visão Geral

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| label: vb-overview
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Fumantes"
v <- overall(dat) |> filter(year == latest_year, indicator == "smoking")
list(
  icon = "lungs",
  color = "danger",
  value = if (nrow(v) > 0) paste0(round(v$prevalence, 1), "%") else "N/D"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Obesidade"
v <- overall(dat) |> filter(year == latest_year, indicator == "obesity")
list(

  value = if (nrow(v) > 0) paste0(round(v$prevalence, 1), "%") else "N/D"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
```

## Row {height=50%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| label: overview-trend
#| title: "Tendência Temporal — Indicadores-Chave"

key_indicators <- c("smoking", "obesity", "diabetes",
                     "physical_inactivity", "hypertension")
key_labels <- c("Fumante", "Obesidade", "Diabetes",
                "Inatividade Física", "Hipertensão")

trend <- overall(dat) |>
  filter(indicator %in% key_indicators) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label_pt, levels = unique(label_pt)))

if (nrow(trend) > 0) {
  plot_ly(trend, x = ~year, y = ~prevalence, color = ~label_pt,
          colors = pal, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          hovertemplate = paste(
            "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>",
            "Ano: %{x}<br>",
            "Prevalência: %{y:.1f}%<br>",
            "<extra></extra>"
          )) |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Ano", dtick = 2),
      yaxis = list(title = "Prevalência (%)", rangemode = "tozero"),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
      hovermode = "x unified"
    )
} else {
  plot_ly() |> layout(title = "Dados não disponíveis")
}
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| label: overview-table
#| title: "Prevalência por Capital (Último Ano)"

cap_data <- dat |>
  filter(year == latest_year, capital != "Total",
         sex == "Total", age_group == "Total", education == "Total",
         indicator %in% c("smoking", "obesity", "diabetes", "hypertension")) |>
  select(Capital = capital, Indicador = label_pt,
         `Prevalência (%)` = prevalence) |>
  mutate(`Prevalência (%)` = round(`Prevalência (%)`, 1)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Indicador, values_from = `Prevalência (%)`)

datatable(cap_data, rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE,
                         dom = "ftip", language = list(
                           search = "Buscar:",
                           lengthMenu = "Mostrar _MENU_ registros",
                           info = "Mostrando _START_ a _END_ de _TOTAL_ registros"
                         )))
```

## Row {height=30%}

```{r}
#| label: overview-region
#| title: "Prevalência por Região (Último Ano)"

reg_data <- dat |>
  filter(year == latest_year, region != "Total", capital == "Total",
         sex == "Total", age_group == "Total", education == "Total",
         indicator %in% key_indicators)

if (nrow(reg_data) > 0) {
  plot_ly(reg_data, x = ~region, y = ~prevalence, color = ~label_pt,
          colors = pal, type = "bar",
          hovertemplate = paste(
            "<b>%{fullData.name}</b><br>",
            "Região: %{x}<br>",
            "Prevalência: %{y:.1f}%<br>",
            "<extra></extra>"
          )) |>
    layout(
      barmode = "group",
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Prevalência (%)", rangemode = "tozero"),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3)
    )
} else {
  plot_ly() |> layout(title = "Dados não disponíveis")
}
```

### Row {height=50%}

#### Column

```{r}
#| label: smoking-capital
#| title: "Comparação por Capital (Último Ano)"

cap_sa <- dat |>
  filter(year == latest_year, capital != "Total",
         sex == "Total", age_group == "Total", education == "Total",
         indicator == "smoking") |>
  arrange(desc(prevalence))

if (nrow(cap_sa) > 0) {
  plot_ly(cap_sa, y = ~reorder(capital, prevalence), x = ~prevalence,
          type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = pal[1]),
          error_x = list(type = "data",
                         symmetric = FALSE,
                         array = cap_sa$ci_upper - cap_sa$prevalence,
                         arrayminus = cap_sa$prevalence - cap_sa$ci_lower),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>Prevalência: %{x:.1f}%<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Prevalência (%)"),
      yaxis = list(title = ""),
      margin = list(l = 120)
    )
} else {
  plot_ly() |> layout(title = "Dados não disponíveis")
}
```

```{r}
  arrange(desc(prevalence))

if (nrow(cap_ap) > 0) {
  plot_ly(cap_ap, y = ~reorder(capital, prevalence), x = ~prevalence,
          type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = pal[3]),
          error_x = list(type = "data",
                         symmetric = FALSE,
                         array = cap_ap$ci_upper - cap_ap$prevalence,
                         arrayminus = cap_ap$prevalence - cap_ap$ci_lower),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>Prevalência: %{x:.1f}%<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Prevalência (%)"),
      yaxis = list(title = ""),
      margin = list(l = 120)
    )
} else {
  plot_ly() |> layout(title = "Dados não disponíveis")
}
```

#### Column

```{r}
#| label: access-region
#| title: "Plano de Saúde por Região (Último Ano)"

reg_ap <- dat |>
  filter(year == latest_year, region != "Total", capital == "Total",
         sex == "Total", age_group == "Total", education == "Total",
         indicator == "health_insurance")

if (nrow(reg_ap) > 0) {
  plot_ly(reg_ap, x = ~region, y = ~prevalence,
          type = "bar",
          marker = list(color = pal[3]),
          error_y = list(type = "data",
                         symmetric = FALSE,
                         array = reg_ap$ci_upper - reg_ap$prevalence,
                         arrayminus = reg_ap$prevalence - reg_ap$ci_lower),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Prevalência: %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Prevalência (%)", rangemode = "tozero")
    )
} else {
  plot_ly() |> layout(title = "Dados não disponíveis")
}
```
